title: GA4GH AI Registry: common entry core (v1)
description: Fields carried by every entry regardless of type (internal project documentation Section 3.2). Composed via allOf by each of the five per-type schemas (model-entry, agent-entry, skill-entry, mcp-server-entry, plugin-entry). This schema deliberately does not set unevaluatedProperties or additionalProperties: false, so it can be safely allOf-composed; each per-type schema closes the composed shape itself.
$comment: processing_directives is reserved for a future BREP-Lite field (see internal research notes D7/R4, internal project documentation Section 3.4, internal project documentation Section 6.8). Do not define this property until the Workstream reconciles ADR-008's directive vocabulary against Model Card Section 6.8a's vocabulary.

id.description: Registry slug, unique within its type. Used as the filename stem (data/<type>/<id>.json) and in machine-readable output keys.

type.description: The content type this entry belongs to. Closed enumeration (internal project documentation Section 4.2, internal project documentation Section 3.2). Six values as of Phase 10 (internal project documentation): the original five plus "bundle", added as a schema minor-version amendment, not a v1 rewrite.

summary.description: Single line, used in listings and search results.

description.description: Markdown, unbounded, rendered on the detail page.

license.description: An SPDX licence identifier present in schemas/vocab/licenses.json, or the literal string "other" paired with a required license_url. Allow-list membership is enforced by scripts/validate.ts, not by this schema, so the allow-list can grow without a schema change.

license_url.description: Required when license is "other"; a URL to the full licence text.

maintainers.description: At least one maintainer, used for CODEOWNERS-style attribution and submitter-authorisation review (internal project documentation Section 7).

orcid.description: ORCID iD, if the maintainer has one.

version.description: The version of the underlying model, agent, skill, server, or plugin that this entry indexes.

keywords.description: Free-text search facet terms. May be empty.

category.description: A single value from the per-type category vocabulary (schemas/vocab/categories/<type>.json). Plugin entries use free text in v1 per internal project documentation Section 3.6.

ga4gh_standards.description: Optional. The coarse, version-free browse and search facet for which GA4GH API specification(s) this entry touches, e.g. trs, drs, beacon, htsget. Values are bare kebab-case identifiers and MUST NOT carry a version suffix, because a versioned facet value splits one standard across multiple buckets and breaks filtering. A version-qualified implementation claim belongs in the type-specific block instead (for mcp-server entries, server._meta['org.ga4gh/ai-registry'].ga4gh_standards[]). Open-ended in v1: no closed vocab file backs this field (internal project documentation Section 3.6 lists only licenses, categories, harnesses, and safety-schemes as closed vocabularies).

safety_classification.description: Scheme-qualified safety classifications (internal project documentation Section 3.3). May be empty: an entry MAY carry zero, one, or both schemes. Never a bare level: every rendered entry MUST show its scheme alongside its level.

certification_tier.description: ADR-003's three-tier certification model, verbatim. Defaults to unsigned; a submission arriving with any other value MUST be rejected at Workflow 1 (internal project documentation Section 3.2). Only a maintainer-authored edit against an existing entry may raise it.

record.description: Provenance block shown on every detail page (internal project documentation Section 5.2).

created.description: When this entry was first merged to data/.

updated.description: The merge date of the most recent accepted change (internal project documentation Section 5.5).

last_verified.description: When a maintainer last confirmed this entry's claims, independent of a content edit.

source_issue.description: The GitHub issue number that produced this entry via the submission pipeline. Omitted for entries authored directly by a maintainer through a pull request that never passed through an issue (internal project documentation Section 6, Workflow 3).

SafetyClassification.description: One safety or certification claim, scheme-qualified per internal project documentation Section 3.3. The registry represents the source scale; it does not adjudicate between the GASE and agent-runtime-risk GASL scales.

scheme.description: The issuing scheme. Closed enumeration, backed by schemas/vocab/safety-schemes.json; extensible by adding a value, never by editing an existing one's meaning.

level.description: The level, in the issuing scheme's own notation: e.g. "GASL-2" or "GASL-3E" for ga4gh-gase; "0" through "4" for ga4gh-agent-runtime-risk. Never normalised or cross-mapped to the other scheme.

certifying_body.description: Who issued or performed the certification, if known.

valid_until.description: When the classification expires, if it does.

evidence_uri.description: Link to the certification record or evaluation report.

source.description: How this classification entered the registry.
